item.title: Juan Soto and Francisco Lindor move on in 2026
item.description: Since the start of the offseason back in October, the Mets have insisted the clubhouse wasn't toxic last season, yet the narrative has followed the team into spring training. It appears as though it's going to continue following them until they show people otherwise.

item.title: Manhattan clubgoers celebrate Haitian music and culture at long-running Kompa Tuesdays
item.description: The weekly event at The DL on Delancey St. serves as a hub for people to network while chowing down on Haitian specialties like a fritay platter.

item.title: US beats Germany to stay unbeaten at the Olympics, but Canada is the top seed
item.description: Auston Matthews scored twice and set up Zach Werenski’s goal with a textbook pass, Connor Hellebuyck stopped 23 of the 24 shots he faced and the U.S. defeated Germany 5-1 on Sunday night to finish group play at the Olympics unbeaten and clinch the second seed in the knockout round.

item.title: Queens man who survived heart attack urges: ‘Don’t wait’ for symptoms
item.description: A long-time Queens resident, Chris Ortiz went to a nearby gym last summer expecting nothing more dramatic than his usual workout.But within minutes that day, his heart stopped, then started again after a defibrillator shock — turning an ordinary Sunday into the kind of save that emergency doctors call rare, defying otherwise long odds of survival.

item.title: Man fatally shot in Queens laundromat where he worked with his mom
item.description: A man fatally shot in the head outside a Queens laundromat was working with his mother overnight when an argument erupted inside the facility and spilled into the street, the Daily News has learned. item.title: Tyler Reddick wins the Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win.

item.title: DNA recovered from glove resembling Guthrie doorbell cam suspect
item.description: DNA has been recovered from a glove resembling those worn by the shadowy figure who appeared on doorbell camera footage the night Nancy Guthrie went missing from her Tucson home, authorities said Sunday.

item.title: 2026 NBA All-Star Game was a success — right until it wasn’t
item.description: The NBA’s new World vs USA vs USA format gave birth to one of the most competitive All-Star Games in the last decade, right up until the undefeated, aging USA Stripes team ran out of gas in their third game of the night, a 20-point loss to a younger, seemingly hungrier American team that won the championship despite losing its first game of the night to the same team it beat to win the All-Star crown.
